provider_credentials_active_telegram_bot.name: provider_credentials_active_telegram_bot_unique
provider_credentials_active_telegram_bot.where: "provider_credentials"."status" = 'active' AND "provider_credentials"."kind" IN ('telegram-admin', 'telegram-client') AND "provider_credentials"."external_resource_id" IS NOT NULL

provider_credentials_owner_scope_check.name: provider_credentials_owner_scope_check
provider_credentials_owner_scope_check.value: ("provider_credentials"."owner_scope" = 'platform' AND "provider_credentials"."tenant_id" IS NULL AND "provider_credentials"."project_id" IS NULL) OR ("provider_credentials"."owner_scope" = 'tenant' AND "provider_credentials"."tenant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_credentials"."project_id" IS NULL) OR ("provider_credentials"."owner_scope" = 'project' AND "provider_credentials"."tenant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_credentials"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)
